source_first_basis: The attributed New Jersey Appellate Division decision records thirteen requested FRT discovery categories, two produced categories, eleven categories denied by the trial court, and appellate reversal directing production of the remaining technical material under available protective review. No evidence establishes completed later delivery or inspection.
decision_abstract: Admit FC-045 failure as the sole independent protected-discovery denial property; reject prior FC-044 duplicate mapping because its revised v0.8.1 all-role exclusion is established, without rejecting the court-supported harm or material need for inspection. Retain independently engaged FC-046 evidence/authority Boundary. Preserve the original wrongful denial and separately identify the later appellate corrective order without inventing actual production.

literal_v081_exclusions.literal_v081_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The only distinct property is absence or failure of a governed pathway for an external authority to obtain protected evidence, with no separately evidenced direct-inspection accessibility property. Assess Authorised Investigative Evidence Access. Both classes may be admitted only where distinct properties or episodes independently satisfy their conditions.
literal_v081_exclusions.assessment: E004-E005 evidence shows the direct-inspection inability arose solely because the court-governed discovery pathway refused protected technical FRT categories. The bare RTCC result lacks underlying technical detail, which explains the material need for discovery; the record supplies no second inspection-environment, artefact-opening, rendering, or access-channel defect that would survive adequate protected production. This satisfies the *revised* all-role exclusion: the only independently demonstrated defect is governed protected-evidence withholding (FC-045), not a separately evidenced FC-044 direct-inspection accessibility failure. The original withholding remains a supported failure under FC-045.

material_distinctions.FC-044: Primary-evidence accessibility conditions are prima facie engaged: underlying technical properties cannot be learned from RTCC nomination alone, and defence could not inspect. However the only demonstrated causal access impediment is the judicial protected-production refusal; there is no independent subsequent direct-inspection route or defect beyond the FC-045 protected access question. All-role exclusion operative. Remove duplicate mapped failure, retain as considered rejected candidate in the two material episodes.
material_distinctions.FC-045: Criminal defence discovery in the live proceedings has an independently grounded lawful basis and is a protected-evidence investigative access route. Denial of eleven non-public FRT categories prevented effective scoped scrutiny. The appellate court ordered those categories produced; later order corroborates original deficiency but does not demonstrate subsequent compliant production. All five failure conditions established, no operative exclusion.
material_distinctions.FC-046: RTCC lead determined who appeared in the arrays; the victim and manager identified the suspect separately before charge. No evidence establishes that FRT inference alone bound the charging authority, nor that the independent decision threshold was properly satisfied. Keep Boundary and precise missing facts; do not infer wrongful arrest or match correctness.

chronology_and_temporal_non_erasure.E004_original_denial: Retain supported adverse outcome under FC-045; 2 categories produced and 11 withheld pending trial-court denial.
chronology_and_temporal_non_erasure.E005_later_correction: Appellate reversal and order to produce; no established actual document delivery or secured inspection, so no independently observed later successful-invariant access outcome.
chronology_and_temporal_non_erasure.non_erasure: The appellate order neither retroactively validates the initial refusal nor supplies proof of completed remedy.
